# ColorCodex Tools — Full Agent Reference

## Overview
ColorCodex Tools (https://www.colorcodetools.com/) is a public, read-only color tools website. It provides:
- Color picker with image picker, color wheel, harmonies, variations, conversions, contrast checks, palettes, and color blindness simulator.
- Reference of 140 HTML/CSS named colors with Hex, RGB, and HSL codes.
- Hex <-> RGB <-> HSL conversion utilities.
- Color chart and color library by category.

## Languages Supported
English, 中文 (zh), 日本語 (ja), 한국어 (ko), Español (es), Français (fr), Deutsch (de), Português (pt).

## API
- OpenAPI: https://www.colorcodetools.com/openapi.json
- Base: https://www.colorcodetools.com/api/agent
- GET /colors — list all 140 named colors
- GET /colors/{name} — lookup color by name (case-insensitive)
- GET /convert?hex=DC143C — hex to RGB/HSL
- No authentication. Public read-only.

## MCP
- Server card: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Endpoint: POST https://www.colorcodetools.com/mcp
- Session: stateless
- Tools: lookup-color, convert-color

## Skills
- Index: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- Artifact: https://www.colorcodetools.com/ai/skills/site-lookup/SKILL.md

## ARD
- Catalog: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json

## Auth
- Status: under construction, not available
- Detail: https://www.colorcodetools.com/auth.md
- Authorization server: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server
- Protected resource: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- JWKS: https://www.colorcodetools.com/.well-known/jwks.json (keys:[] disabled)

## Source Data
- data-names.js (140 named colors, verified against MDN)
- data-library.js (categorized color library)
- data-chart.js (chart data)

## Limitations
- Read-only; no write, account, or auth operations.
- /agent-auth/* endpoints return 503.
- List endpoint returns all 140 colors in one response; no pagination.

Last updated: 2026-09-15
